title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Maruclap in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Maruclap in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2543_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Maruclap and Cotocoto in the barrio of Haliging Kanluran, Maarangan in the barrio of Haliging Silangan, Cacawan in the barrio of Sto. Niño, and Payapa in the barrio of Talahib Payapa, all in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, are separated from the said barrios, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Maruclap.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
